cues: Many Greeks believe history began with Homer and Plato.
Chinese nationalists retort that it began with the Yellow Emperor, and that everyone else's achievements are pale copies.
Some Hindu nativists claim that ancient sages invented aeroplanes and nuclear weapons.
Pious Muslims see history before the Prophet as largely irrelevant; Turkish, Iranian and Egyptian nationalists add that their own nation was the fountainhead.
British, French, Germans, Americans and Japanese are each convinced that without them humankind would live in barbarous ignorance.
And the Aztecs believed the sun would not rise without their sacrifices.
